# Security reports

Please email services@metricowl.cloud with a concise reproduction and affected version. Do not include passwords, setup keys, recovery codes, API tokens, private SSH keys or unredacted server logs. Use synthetic examples where possible.

The project is a private preview. Its panel and MCP bridge are intended for local access or an authenticated SSH connection. Do not expose the administrator port directly to the internet. See docs/SECURITY.md for the supported boundaries. This contact does not promise a response time or support service level.
